title: Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) Installment Parameters by Plan
content:
# Installment Parameters — Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans)

Billing Department schedule of the figures used to set a Budget Billing (Levelized and Equal Payment Plans) installment on each plan.

## Parameter table

| Plan | Billing periods of history averaged | Source of the average when the location has short history | Class average monthly bill | Months over which the deferred balance is spread | Months of the year billed at the installment | Rounding of every computed installment | Smallest installment | Member may set the installment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Levelized Billing Rolling Average | 12 | location history | $142.00 | 12 | 12 | up to the next whole dollar | $25.00 | No |
| Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up | 12 | location history | $142.00 | 12 | 12 | up to the next whole dollar | $25.00 | No |
| Budget Billing Quarterly Review | 12 | location history | $142.00 | 12 | 12 | up to the next whole dollar | $25.00 | No |
| Farm Budget Billing | 12 | location history | $198.00 | 12 | 12 | up to the next whole dollar | $40.00 | No |
| Small Business Budget Billing | 12 | location history | $236.00 | 12 | 12 | up to the next whole dollar | $50.00 | No |
| Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan | 12 | location history | $142.00 | 10 | 10 | up to the next whole dollar | $40.00 | No |

## Definitions of the columns

- **Billing periods of history averaged.** The number of billing periods of the service account's own history whose bills are averaged for the installment: 12 on every plan.
- **Location history.** Where a location has short history, the average uses the location's own prior billing under other members, and then the class average.
- **Class average monthly bill.** The average monthly bill of the rate class, used when the location has no history: $142.00 on Levelized Billing Rolling Average, Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up, Budget Billing Quarterly Review and the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan, $198.00 on Farm Budget Billing and $236.00 on Small Business Budget Billing.
- **Spread months.** The number of months over which the deferred balance is spread when an installment is computed: 12, except 10 on the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan.
- **Months billed at the installment.** The months of the year billed at the installment amount: 12, except 10 on the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan.
- **Rounding.** On every plan each computed installment is rounded up to the next whole dollar; an amount already in whole dollars is unchanged.
- **Smallest installment.** No installment is below $25.00 on Levelized Billing Rolling Average, Budget Billing Annual Settle-Up and Budget Billing Quarterly Review, $40.00 on Farm Budget Billing and the Ten-Month Equal Payment Plan, and $50.00 on Small Business Budget Billing.
- **Member may set the installment.** On no plan may the member set the installment amount.

## Hypothetical illustrations of the rounding and floor columns

|---|---|---|---|---|
| $118.03 | Budget Billing Quarterly Review | $119.00 | $25.00 | $119.00 |
| $36.20 | Farm Budget Billing | $37.00 | $40.00 | $40.00 |
| $36.20 | Levelized Billing Rolling Average | $37.00 | $25.00 | $37.00 |
| $210.00 | Small Business Budget Billing | $210.00 | $50.00 | $210.00 |
